SUBSTITUTE NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment 22733T1
3026 North Clybourn Street
From C1-2 to a B2-2

The Property

The subject property is improved with a two-and-a-half-story detached residence with two
dwelling units, a basement, and a detached rear-yard garage. The subject property is located on
a block improved with buildings of various heights that contain residential, commercial, and
mixed uses—which consist of ground floor commercial space with residential uses above. The
subject property is in a Transit Served Location per the Transit-Oriented Provisions of the
Chicago Zoning Ordinance as it is located within 1,320 feet from the Western Avenue CTA Bus
Line Corridor Roadway Segment (49, X49, 49B).

The Project

The Applicant seeks to rezone the property to construct a three-story, three-unit residential
building, a two-car garage, and three bicycle spaces. The height of the building will be thirty-eight
feet. To allow the proposed development, the Applicant seeks a change in zoning classification for
the subject property from a C1-2 Neighborhood Commercial District to a B2-2 Neighborhood
Mixed-Use District. The Applicant is filing a Type 1 rezoning application and is seeking an
administrative adjustment under 17-13-1003-EE to decrease the number of automobile parking
spaces to two spaces.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 3,500 square feet

Floor Area: 6,300 square feet

Maximum FAR: 18

Residential Dwelling Units: 3

MLA Density: 1,166.67 square feet

Height: 38 feet

Automobile Parking: 2

Bicycle Parking: 3

Setbacks: Front (North Clybourn): 5.0 feet
South Side: 3.0 feet
North Side: 3.0 feet
Rear (Alley): 46.0 feet
